summary.text: Joe Lovvorn, a Republican, has represented Alabama House District 79 since 2016 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: He received his undergraduate degree and an M.B.A. from Auburn University.
His professional experience includes serving as a firefighter, working as a realtor and owning a Two Men and a Truck franchise.
He has served on the board of directors of the Auburn Chamber of Commerce.
